text: Code reviews are an important practice in software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the software reaches users. This saves time and money because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also help with knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews improve team quality because everyone follows the same standards and writes cleaner code. Although code reviews take extra time, they are worth it. They make the final product more reliable and help the whole team grow together.
